svg.title: AWS VPC Architecture Diagram
svg.desc: Single-AZ VPC with public and private subnets, EC2 instances, and internet gateway

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does internet traffic flow into an AWS VPC?')

sendPrompt('What routes does a public route table need in AWS?')

sendPrompt('What is the role of a bastion or public EC2 instance?')

sendPrompt('What inbound rules should a private EC2 security group have?')
sendPrompt('Why would you put an EC2 instance in a private subnet?')
